summary: We’re looking for a Senior Frontend Developer who goes beyond writing code and takes real ownership of frontend features. We want someone who enjoys working in a fast-moving, product-driven environment, isn’t afraid to question assumptions, and loves shipping things users actually enjoy using.
responsibilities: Contributing to frontend feature development with a strong focus on quality and performance.
Collaborating closely with the Lead Developer and other team members.
Building slick, responsive, reusable components with React.js, Next.js, and Tailwind.
Optimizing applications for performance, scalability, and UX.
Troubleshooting and resolving complex bugs. Sometimes, before anyone even notices.
Pairing with backend engineers and designers to implement full-stack features.
Testing ideas quickly, giving feedback on UX, and improving what’s already built.
Refactoring older code as the product scales and always improving what you touch.
Sharing insights, patterns, and discoveries with the team through demos, docs, or Slack banter.
required_skills: 2-4 years of frontend experience with React.js, Next.js, and JavaScript (ES6+).
Advanced knowledge of HTML5, CSS3/SASS, Tailwind CSS, and responsive UI.
Deep understanding of component-driven design, state management, and REST API integration.
Familiarity with automated testing tools like Jest, Playwright, or Cypress.
Sharp eye for UI/UX detail and an obsession with frontend performance.
nice_to_have_skills: A portfolio or GitHub showing off real, impactful projects.
Experience working in fast-paced SaaS or product-focused environments.
Familiarity with NPM, Laravel, WordPress development.
